subject: AuthZ chainbreak: SCIM sync samples + SSO assertion handoff
messages:
From: Elena Gomes <elena.gomes@helixhealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 request: SCIM delta + sampled SAML assertions

Marcus / Irène —

Our external auditor has flagged a potential gap in the authorization chain for a sample of tenants. They need: 1) a small SCIM delta for the last 30 days showing role membership changes for 3 tenants, 2) raw SAML assertion examples (redacted PII OK) tied to the same tenant timelines, and 3) a short note that explains how role assignments are reconciled to your source-of-truth and where least-privilege verification happens.

Can you confirm you can provide a sampling (preferably CSV for SCIM deltas) and 2–3 SAML assertion text files by EOD Tuesday (UTC)? Also include a retention policy pointer so the auditor can validate custody. If you have a workback plan (timeline + owners) that would be perfect.

Elena
Senior Security Manager
Helix Health

P.S. auditor id: EXT-SOC2-HX-211 — they asked for direct contact if anything blocks you.

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Elena Gomes <elena.gomes@helixhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: SCIM delta + sampled SAML assertions

Thanks Elena — we can do that. High-level plan:

- Hannah will pull the SCIM delta slices for the three tenants you named and export as CSV (covering role add/removes + timestamps).
- Irène will export SAML assertion examples (redacted, with attribute mapping notes).
- I will own the write-up explaining reconciliation to our identity source and where least-privilege checks occur (role owner tags + quarterly pruning job).

We expect to deliver the first-pass artifacts by 2028-07-02 18:00 UTC and the explanatory note + workback timeline by 2028-07-03 12:00 UTC. If the auditor needs raw logs instead of deltas we can escalate.

Are these cutoff times OK? We'll attach: scim_delta_sample.csv (partial), saml_assertion_examples.txt, and a brief workback_timeline.xlsx once ready.

-Marcus Lin
Manager, Access & Authorization Operations
Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-02T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: SCIM delta + sampled SAML assertions

Elena / Marcus —

Attached are the initial artifact stubs for the auditor to consume:
- scim_delta_sample.csv (rows: tenant_id, user_id, old_role, new_role, change_ts) — contains 3 tenant slices, redacted user IDs (uid-###)
- saml_assertion_examples.txt (3 assertions; attributes preserved, names/PII redacted)
- workback_timeline.xlsx (owners and delivery ETA)

Notes / caveats:
- We filtered the SCIM export to role-related events only; service-account diffs are excluded (auditor asked for user role edits).
- The SAML assertions include timestamped SubjectConfirmation and AttributeStatement blocks; we removed raw email addresses and replaced them with masked tokens in accordance with Helix's redaction guidance.
- Retention: assertions and delta logs are retained in our audit store for 90 days by default; archival policy exists beyond that on request. I added the retention pointer in the timeline spreadsheet.

Attachments: [attachment: scim_delta_sample.csv (csv)], [attachment: saml_assertion_examples.txt (txt)], [attachment: workback_timeline.xlsx (xlsx)]

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Security Analyst, Access Controls
Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-07-03T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: SCIM delta + sampled SAML assertions

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the artifacts look good at a glance. Two small follow-ups from the auditor: 1) can you include the attribute mapping that shows which SAML attribute maps to Redwood role_id and where that mapping is recorded (a screenshot or small CSV is fine), and 2) please confirm the event timestamps in the SCIM delta are UTC and include timezone in the CSV header.

Also: the auditor requested a one-line confirmation that role reconciliation runs automatically and the frequency (daily/weekly) so they can reference it in the SOC2 narrative. Could you add that to the workback_timeline.xlsx and resend?

If you can get those two quick changes by 2028-07-04 08:00 UTC we'll be in good shape for next-week evidence review.

Elena
Senior Security Manager
Helix Health
